explanation: Fires only at the D1 step, and only when the previous trial chose a1, reached S2 through a rare transition and got no reward: then it is about 8-10 (about 4 if that rare-S2 trial was rewarded, and occasionally about 10 after a2 reached S2 commonly with no reward). This happens mostly in the first ~30 trials of the episode and fades to about 0-5 later; every GO and D2 step, and every other D1 (including after unrewarded common transitions), is 0.
